stories.title: Passenger vehicle sales hit record 5.19 lakh units in October
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle sales rose 12.4 percent to 519,060 units in October, marking the strongest performance ever recorded for the month, according to the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers. Two-wheeler sales increased 16.1 percent to 2.58 million units. The industry continues to witness healthy demand momentum.

stories.title: India passenger vehicle dispatches cross 5 lakh units in October
stories.summary: Automakers dispatched 519,060 passenger vehicles to dealerships in October, a 12.4 percent year-on-year increase. The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers described the result as the segment's strongest-ever October performance. Two-wheeler dispatches rose 16.1 percent to 2.58 million units during the same period.

stories.title: SIAM reports record October passenger vehicle sales
stories.summary: Domestic passenger vehicle sales reached 519,060 units in October, a 12.4 percent increase over the previous year. The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers noted this is the first time monthly dispatches have crossed the 5-lakh mark in October. These figures exclude data from several luxury manufacturers.

stories.title: Car sales hit record 5.19 lakh in October
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle sales reached 519,060 units in October, a 12.4 percent increase from the year-ago period. The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers attributed the growth to healthy demand momentum during the festive season. Two-wheeler sales also remained healthy, indicating strong interest among entry-level buyers.

stories.title: Passenger vehicle sales cross 500,000 in October
stories.summary: Passenger vehicle sales rose 12.4 percent to 519,060 units in October, the best October on record. Utility vehicles led the segment with 301,141 units, while two-wheeler sales grew 16.1 percent. The industry posted a strong month as sales crossed the 5 lakh mark for the first time.

stories.title: Auto sales stay strong in October, post double-digit growth: SIAM - Moneycontrol.com
India auto industry clocks record October sales
stories.summary: Domestic passenger vehicle sales grew 12.4 percent to 519,060 units in October, crossing the 5 lakh mark for the first time in the month. Utility vehicles led the segment with 301,141 units. Two-wheeler sales surged 16.1 percent to 2.58 million units, with scooters recording a 31.6 percent jump.

stories.title: India's auto industry accelerates in October: Passenger vehicle sales hit record 5.19 lakh, two-wheelers jump 16% - SME
Passenger vehicle and two-wheeler dispatches soar in October
stories.summary: Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches reached a record 519,060 units in October, a 12.4 percent year-on-year increase. The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers stated the segment achieved its strongest-ever October performance. Two-wheeler sales also surged by over 16 percent, driven by festive demand and improved market conditions.

stories.title: Nissan Magnite leads sales in October
stories.summary: Nissan India reported that the Magnite remained its best-selling vehicle in October, despite facing year-on-year declines. The company also saw a response to the 7-seater Gravitas MPV, while sales of the Tecton SUV saw a significant drop. The Magnite starts at 5.69 lakh.

stories.title: JSW Motors to unveil new SUV in December
stories.summary: JSW Motors plans to unveil its new passenger vehicle company on December 3. The firm's first SUV, expected to be named Combat, is based on the Jetour T2 manufactured by Chery. JSW and Chery have entered a partnership to bring the vehicle to the Indian market.

stories.title: Mahindra XUV400 sales drop 50 percent
stories.summary: Mahindra sold 73,338 units in October, led by the Scorpio. However, the XUV400 electric SUV saw sales fall to 76 units, a 50 percent decline year-on-year. The company is currently seeing higher demand for its newer electric models, including the BE 6 and XEV 9e.

stories.title: Hyundai and Tata prepare new electric SUVs
stories.summary: Hyundai and Tata Motors are planning to launch new electric SUVs in the Indian market next year. Hyundai is developing a sub-compact electric SUV codenamed HE1i, expected by March 2027. Tata Motors is preparing to unveil the next generation of its Nexon EV.

stories.title: Toyota Fortuner update expected in 2027
stories.summary: Toyota will debut an updated Fortuner globally on December 1, 2026, in South Africa. The vehicle is expected to feature revised styling and an upgraded cabin. An India launch is anticipated in 2027, though the company has not yet provided an official date or pricing.

stories.title: New Toyota Fortuner spied ahead of December reveal
stories.summary: Toyota is preparing a generational update for the Fortuner, with a test vehicle recently photographed in Argentina. The SUV is expected to make its global debut on December 1, 2026. An India launch is possible in 2027, but Toyota has not announced a specific date or lineup.

stories.title: Tata Motors reports 20.87 percent year-on-year sales growth
stories.summary: Tata Motors sold 73,894 passenger vehicles in October, an increase of 12,760 units over the previous year. The Nexon and Punch models accounted for 57.5 percent of total sales. The newly launched Aeris model recorded the largest month-on-month gain in the company's lineup.

stories.title: Honda to launch ALPHA electric SUV in December
stories.summary: Honda Cars India will launch its first electric SUV, the ALPHA, on December 2, 2026. The vehicle is the production version of the 0 Alpha concept. Honda plans to introduce several global nameplates to the Indian market, including both locally-made products and imported units.

stories.title: Toyota and Honda to debut new SUVs on December 1
stories.summary: Toyota and Honda will both unveil new seven-seater SUVs on December 1, 2026. Toyota is introducing the next-generation Fortuner, while Honda will debut the Avancier. The models are expected to offer three-row seating, with the Fortuner focusing on ruggedness and the Avancier on hybrid technology.

stories.title: Royal Enfield achieves record quarterly sales
stories.summary: Royal Enfield sold 376,722 motorcycles between July and September 2026, marking a 15 percent year-on-year increase. The manufacturer reported its highest-ever quarterly sales, citing growth in both domestic and international markets driven by new models and updates. The company is currently expanding its product range.

stories.title: Hero Xpulse 450 enters adventure segment
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has unveiled the Xpulse 450, featuring a 421cc engine and smartphone integration. The motorcycle enters the middleweight adventure segment to compete with the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, which utilizes a 452cc engine. Both models are designed for highway use and long-travel suspension capabilities.

stories.title: Ducati launches Desmo450 EDX in India
stories.summary: Ducati has launched the Desmo450 EDX at Rs 18.55 lakh and the 2027 Desmo450 MX Factory at Rs 21.26 lakh. Both models share a 449.6cc single-cylinder engine but serve different purposes, with the EDX focused on trail riding and the MX Factory designed for motocross racing.

stories.title: Bajaj to expand lineup with adventure and electric models
stories.summary: Bajaj Auto plans to launch an adventure motorcycle globally by December 2026, with an all-electric model expected to follow by fiscal year 2028. While the adventure bike has been spotted during test runs, the company has not yet begun testing for its mass-market electric motorcycle.

stories.title: Two-wheeler market sees diverse updates
stories.summary: The Indian two-wheeler market recently saw new color options for the TVS Ntorq 150 and patent filings from VinFast. BGauss surpassed 1 lakh cumulative electric scooter sales since 2022. Additionally, Jawa Yezdi and BSA showcased new models, including the Bantam Bobber 350, at EICMA 2026.

stories.title: Royal Enfield CEO notes slow electric adoption
stories.summary: Royal Enfield expects electric motorcycle adoption to take time, noting that bookings for its Flying Flea C6 are converting slowly despite encouraging initial enquiries. The company plans a gradual expansion of its electric business, acknowledging that it is building a market currently dominated by electric scooters.

stories.title: Himalayan 750 and BMW F 450 GS compared
stories.summary: The Royal Enfield Himalayan 750 features a 743cc parallel-twin engine and touring equipment. It competes in the adventure segment against the BMW F 450 GS, which uses a 420cc parallel-twin motor. Both motorcycles include modern rider aids and are positioned for different approaches to weight and power.

stories.title: Royal Enfield reveals Himalayan 750 specs
stories.summary: Royal Enfield debuted the Himalayan 750 at EICMA 2026, confirming a 743cc parallel-twin engine, adjustable Showa suspension, and five riding modes. European pricing is available and bookings are open, though the company has not yet confirmed an official launch date for the Indian market.

stories.title: Nissan NX7 PHEV launches with 200-mile electric range
stories.summary: Dongfeng Nissan has opened orders for the NX7 hybrid, which offers up to 198 miles of electric range from a 40 kWh battery. The vehicle is priced at $20,000. The company aims to improve upon the range limitations of its earlier electric models for the SUV market.

stories.title: Nissan NX7 opens pre-sales at 129,900 CNY as N-series retail slides 14.5% - GlobalChinaEV
Green SM electric taxis to expand in India
stories.summary: Vietnamese operator Green SM has secured regulatory approval to launch its all-electric taxi service in Bengaluru and Chennai. Backed by Vingroup, the company is accelerating its Indian expansion after previously entering the Delhi-NCR and Hyderabad markets to compete in the urban ride-hailing sector.

stories.title: May Mobility Plans 10,000+ Volkswagen ID. Buzz Robotaxis by 2031 - Electric Cars Report
Gurugram-based Delhivery, India's largest fully integrated logistics provider, has partnered with Tata Motors, Euler Mot
Green SM to expand electric mobility services across six Indian states, UTs - ET Auto
Delhivery Partners Tata Motors, Euler Motors And Montra Electric For EV Fleet Expansion - ACKO Drive
Tata Motors reports 90 percent EV sales growth
stories.summary: Tata Motors reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 5,531 crore for the September quarter, despite a 90 percent year-on-year increase in electric vehicle volumes. Domestic passenger vehicle revenue rose 51 percent, though overall performance was impacted by a one-time loss and results from Jaguar Land Rover.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland profit climbs 8.7 percent
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 891 crore for the second quarter, an 8.7 percent increase over the previous year. Revenue rose 35 percent to Rs 17,030 crore, though profitability was affected by a 45 percent jump in the cost of materials and services.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland declares interim dividend
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland has approved its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and declared an interim dividend of Rs 1 per equity share. The company reported growth in commercial vehicle volumes, revenue, and profits for the period.

stories.title: BEV market shifts from subsidies to regulation
stories.summary: The global battery electric vehicle market is transitioning from a subsidy-dependent niche to a regulation-driven mass market, according to IndexBox. The industry is now focused on total cost of ownership parity to attract mainstream consumers. The market has apparently decided to stop relying on handouts.

stories.title: BMW U.S. sales rise as electric demand cools
stories.summary: BMW reported a 13 percent increase in U.S. sales for the second quarter, reaching 102,713 vehicles. However, combined deliveries of fully electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids fell 18.1 percent. The company is performing well overall, provided customers do not choose the electric options.

stories.title: CRRC importer to open plant in former Maserati factory
stories.summary: Swiss-based YES-EU has signed a preliminary agreement to acquire a former Maserati factory in Italy. The company plans to begin producing electric buses, minibuses, and battery systems at the Grugliasco site by 2028. The facility is currently preparing for its new, less Italian, future.

stories.title: Toyota to build kei trucks in Indiana
stories.summary: Toyota is reviving the Scion brand to sell the KEI-01, a rebadged Daihatsu Hijet Jumbo. The tiny trucks will be built at the company's factory in Princeton, Indiana. The automaker is aiming to capture the American market with a vehicle designed for much smaller roads.

stories.title: Fleet body urges government to keep 2030 car target
stories.summary: The Association of Fleet Professionals wants the government to maintain its 80 percent sales target for new electric cars by 2030. However, it recommends lowering the goal for electric vans from 70 percent to 40 percent. The industry is requesting a more flexible pace for larger vehicles.

stories.title: Fleet group seeks lower electric van targets
stories.summary: The Association of Fleet Professionals has asked the government to stick to its 2030 target for new electric cars while reducing the goal for electric vans to 40 percent. The group warns that current mandates could lead to weaker supply and higher prices for fleet operators.

stories.title: CNH to build tractor plant in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: CNH has laid the foundation for a new tractor manufacturing plant in Jewar, India. The company plans to invest 2,000 crore rupees by 2030 to double its annual production capacity to 1.4 lakh units. The facility is located near the upcoming Noida International Airport.

stories.title: Five injured in multi-vehicle accident in Gujarat
stories.summary: A container truck struck a BSF vehicle on the Banas River bridge, causing a tractor-trolley to overturn. Four BSF personnel and the tractor driver were injured in the collision. The tractor narrowly avoided falling into the river during the incident.

stories.title: Sealing market pivots to electric vehicle demand
stories.summary: The automotive seals and gaskets market is entering a new phase focused on reliability and compliance, according to IndexBox. Demand is splitting between traditional parts and high-value components for electric vehicle platforms, such as fire-retardant battery enclosure seals. The industry is finding new ways to keep things contained.

stories.title: Air compressor market grows with premium SUVs
stories.summary: The global automotive air compressor market is bifurcating into long-cycle OEM integration and aftermarket service, IndexBox reports. Growth is driven by the adoption of air suspension in premium SUVs and the continued use of air brakes in commercial vehicles. Air is becoming a premium feature.

stories.title: C-clips market relies on manufacturing cycles
stories.summary: The global C-clips market remains a critical component for securing pins and axles in various assemblies, according to IndexBox. The market's health is tied to production cycles in manufacturing, aerospace, and automotive sectors. It is an essential, if understated, part of keeping things together.

stories.title: PTFE sleeving market navigates regulatory landscape
stories.summary: The global PTFE sleeving market is defined by its role in high-performance industrial applications, IndexBox reports. The sector is currently managing complex supply chains and evolving regulatory pressures. The material remains indispensable for those who require high-performance insulation.

stories.title: Hardness test kits market sees steady demand
stories.summary: The global hardness test kits market is growing as manufacturers prioritize material integrity and compliance, according to IndexBox. Demand remains steady across the automotive, aerospace, and construction sectors. The industry is ensuring that materials meet their required standards before they are put to use.

stories.title: TVS Srichakra Q2 FY27 profit quadruples to ₹44 crore - ET Auto
Warburg Pincus to acquire stake in Pricol unit
stories.summary: Private equity firm Warburg Pincus has agreed to buy a 38.51 percent stake in a new unit of Pricol Ltd for 1,633 crore rupees. The deal follows a demerger of the company's driver information and connected vehicle business. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval.

stories.title: Warburg Pincus to acquire 38.51%promoter stake in Pricol Autotech after proposed demerger - ET Auto
Apollo Tyres to exit bicycle tire business
stories.summary: Apollo Tyres is discontinuing its Vredestein bicycle tire business following an internal review. The company is currently in negotiations with outside parties to potentially keep the 115-year-old brand alive. The future of the Dutch bicycle tire maker remains under discussion.

stories.title: Sonic Automotive reports record quarterly revenue
stories.summary: Sonic Automotive reported record quarterly revenues of 4 billion dollars in its latest earnings call. Management attributed the performance to operating discipline and a refusal to discount inventory to chase sales. The company is attempting to maintain profit margins despite fluctuating consumer demand.

stories.title: Group 1 Automotive reshuffles dealership portfolio
stories.summary: Group 1 Automotive is selling underperforming locations to acquire premium luxury dealerships. The company says this swap will expand margins and improve earnings durability. The retailer aims to control operating costs while capturing high-margin service revenue to survive volatility. The auto cycle remains indifferent to the strategy.

stories.title: Carvana shifts focus to infrastructure and supply
stories.summary: Carvana sold nearly 40 percent more vehicles in the third quarter compared to last year. Management says demand is not the limiting factor, pointing instead to supply chain and reconditioning capacity. The company is now reframing its growth challenge as an execution problem rather than a customer issue.

stories.title: Hertz closes all physical car sales locations
stories.summary: Hertz confirmed it will close all its physical retail stores to deepen its focus on an online retail car sales strategy. The company says it has evolved its approach to meet customers where they want to shop. The stores are now being removed from the map.

stories.title: Kunes Auto Group family member apologizes for viral video
stories.summary: Alaina Kunes, granddaughter of Kunes Auto Group owner Gregg Kunes, has apologized for her actions in a video filmed near the University of Mississippi. The footage, which drew 12 million views, showed the 18-year-old making gestures that prompted accusations of racism. The family is facing renewed attention.

stories.title: Massachusetts car dealer sentenced to prison
stories.summary: Edward Cicciu was sentenced to four to six years in prison after admitting to 120 counts related to selling 47 cars without providing titles. The Swansea dealer owes victims $340,380.76. The business, Bristol County Auto Exchange, is now closed following a police investigation into the missing paperwork.

stories.title: ‘Retail on the Record’ recap: John Bergstrom talks customer satisfaction and the only thing U.S. dealers need to beat Ch
Dealership buyers scrutinize sellers’ advertising practices after FTC warnings - Automotive News
Chery reaches 40,000 UK customers
stories.summary: Chery has reached 40,000 customers in the UK one year after launching. The manufacturer now operates 100 dealerships and registered 3,707 new cars in October, capturing a 2.4 percent market share. Hybrid models are currently the primary driver of the brand's growth in the British market.

stories.title: Allahabad High Court bans forcible vehicle repossession
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court ruled that finance companies cannot use recovery agents to seize vehicles by force. The court held that repossession must be enforced through civil courts or arbitrators. The ruling followed a case where a borrower's vehicle was allegedly seized at gunpoint despite ongoing payments.

stories.title: India sees rise in electric two-wheeler adoption
stories.summary: India sold more than 1.28 million electric two-wheelers in 2025, accounting for 6.3 percent of the total market. Industry analysts suggest that the next phase of adoption will require more than just vehicle availability. The focus is shifting toward making the transition to electric mobility more inclusive.

stories.title: Banks raise lending rates to protect margins
stories.summary: At least five major banks have increased lending rates by up to 25 basis points to protect margins against rising deposit costs. The hikes follow the Reserve Bank of India's recent decision to raise its key lending rate. Lenders are attempting to deploy funds more profitably.

stories.title: Bank holiday schedule for mid-November
stories.summary: Public and private sector banks in India will be closed on 14 and 15 November for the weekend. Branches in Patna and Ranchi will remain closed on 16 November for Chhath Puja. Digital services remain operational while in-branch services are suspended for the duration of the holidays.

stories.title: Irish motorists urged to compare insurance quotes
stories.summary: The Central Bank reports that one in five motorists renew insurance without comparing providers, potentially missing out on €300 in savings. A new transparency code now requires insurers to provide documents detailing market conditions. Consumers are being encouraged to shop around for better prices and suitable cover.

stories.title: BYD's luxury brand Denza enters India with Z9 GT, D9, prices start at ₹90 lakh - ET Auto
Denza Z9 GT enters Indian market
stories.summary: BYD luxury brand Denza has launched the Z9 GT in India at an ex-showroom price of ₹1.57 crore. The electric shooting brake features a 670 km range and premium interior amenities. The model is being imported as a completely built unit to target the high-end electric segment.

stories.title: Denza Z9 GT launches in India
stories.summary: BYD's luxury division Denza has entered the Indian market with the Z9 GT electric shooting brake, priced at ₹1.57 crore. The vehicle features a 122.5 kWh battery and claims a 0 to 100 km/h acceleration of 2.7 seconds. It is being imported as a completely built unit.

stories.title: JSW Motors partners with AWS to host connected-car data in India - Team-BHP
Nvidia leadership reshuffle and the automotive sector
stories.summary: Nvidia is undergoing a leadership transition following the departure of Jensen Huang. While the company maintains extensive partnerships with major automotive manufacturers including Mercedes, Volvo, Toyota, and BYD, industry observers are currently weighing the potential impact of this change on the firm's long-term automotive technology strategy.

stories.title: Nvidia board considers Arm CEO as successor to Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia's board is considering Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO following reports of personal misconduct. Haas, a former Nvidia employee, is currently being evaluated alongside other candidates as the company navigates its leadership transition.

stories.title: Chinese AI projects continue to rely on Nvidia hardware
stories.summary: Despite US export controls intended to restrict access to advanced technology, a Reuters review identified over $3 billion in Chinese AI projects utilizing restricted Nvidia processors. The projects span across multiple provinces, indicating sustained demand for the hardware despite Washington's efforts to curb Beijing's access to the technology.

stories.title: Nvidia technology remains embedded in global automotive fleets
stories.summary: Nvidia continues to supply processors for multimedia and autonomous driving systems to manufacturers including Mercedes, Volvo, Toyota, Xiaomi, and BYD. The company has established a broad network of partnerships that will see its technology integrated into numerous vehicle models scheduled for release in the coming years.

stories.title: Emdoor brings on-device AI to automotive repair workshops - Automotive World
JSW Motors partners with AWS to host connected-car data in India - ET Auto
Automotive logistics in Mexico shifts toward predictive AI
stories.summary: Automotive companies are increasingly adopting AI to move beyond basic shipment tracking toward predictive supply chain management. At the ALSC Mexico 2026 conference, representatives from BMW and GM discussed using digital tools to anticipate disruptions and optimize transport routes, aiming for faster and better-informed operational decision-making.

stories.title: Nvidia appoints interim CEO following Jensen Huang exit
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has stepped down after 33 years as Nvidia's founding CEO. The company has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while searching for a permanent replacement. The transition occurs as the firm deepens its investments in autonomous driving and driver-assistance technologies for the automotive sector.

stories.title: US and India discuss bilateral trade agreement tariffs
stories.summary: The United States has assured India that a proposed bilateral trade agreement will provide more favorable tariff arrangements compared to those offered to competing nations. Officials from both countries are currently negotiating the first phase of the deal, with final benefits contingent upon the completed tariff structure.

stories.title: India negotiates preferential tariff access to US market
stories.summary: Washington has assured New Delhi that Indian exporters will receive a comparative tariff advantage over rivals like Vietnam and Bangladesh under a new bilateral agreement. The deal aims to secure preferential access to the American market, building on negotiations that first commenced in February 2026.

Ottawa pitches higher luxury-tax threshold for EVs - Automotive News
RCMP renews search for car dealership break-in suspect
stories.summary: The Nanaimo RCMP has issued a second public appeal for information regarding the whereabouts of 58-year-old Dereck Paul. Paul is wanted on an outstanding arrest warrant in connection with a July 2025 break-and-enter incident at a car dealership located on Kenworth Road.

stories.title: China’s BYD sets production-car speed record of 312 mph as it opens talks to join Formula 1 - Automotive News
Indian government mandates electric vehicles for official use
stories.summary: The Indian government has designated electric vehicles as the default choice for official ministry and department fleets. The Department of Expenditure has set a purchase price ceiling of 20 lakh rupees for electric models, a higher limit than that permitted for petrol, diesel, or hybrid vehicles.

CTR-JK Tyre FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship Round 2: An action packed race weekend - evo India
Atiqa Mir joins FIA junior development program
stories.summary: Indian racing driver Atiqa Mir has been selected for the 2026 FIA Girls On Track Rising Stars program. She is one of nine junior drivers chosen globally and the only Indian participant in the 12-14 age category for the FIA-backed initiative.

stories.title: Formula E prepares for Gen4 season
stories.summary: The 2026-27 Formula E season introduces the Gen4 single-seater, featuring a new weekend format and updated circuits. Testing begins at Circuito del Jarama on 16 November, with the championship campaign scheduled to start in Mexico this January.

stories.title: Atiqa Mir named to FIA Rising Stars program
stories.summary: Atiqa Mir has been selected as the sole Indian junior driver for the 2026 FIA Girls On Track Rising Stars program. Her selection follows performances in the Champions of the Future Academy and the FIA Karting World Championship. She is among nine drivers chosen globally.

stories.title: Jonny Edgar joins Corvette factory team
stories.summary: British driver Jonny Edgar has joined Corvette Racing as a factory driver for 2027. The 22-year-old recently won the World Endurance Championship LMGT3 title and a class victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours. His specific racing programme for next year remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Kenny Wallace questions NASCAR marketing
stories.summary: NASCAR commentator Kenny Wallace claims the sanctioning body failed to adequately promote Justin Allgaier despite his 2026 championship win. Wallace questioned why NASCAR stopped featuring the veteran driver in its campaigns before his recent title success at Homestead-Miami Speedway.

stories.title: Arvid Lindblad opens up on his Indian culture, Diwali-themed helmet, and his overview of the 2026 F1 season - evo India
Silverlake Automotive Recycling wins industry award
stories.summary: Silverlake Automotive Recycling was named Green Parts Supplier of the Year 2026 at the ABP Night of Knights Awards. The company supplies recycled vehicle parts to the body repair industry, with the winner determined by votes from participating bodyshops.

stories.title: India targets 30 percent EV penetration by 2030
stories.summary: India is pursuing a 30 percent electric vehicle penetration target by 2030, supported by initiatives like FAME-II and PM E-DRIVE. Success depends on domestic battery manufacturing and the ability to secure and retain materials required to power the transition.

stories.title: Service stations deploy marshals to manage charger queues
stories.summary: UK motorway service stations are struggling to keep pace with EV charging demand as grid connection delays persist. Operators are now deploying marshals during peak periods to prevent charge rage among motorists competing for limited available charging points.

stories.title: Greenwheel Electric plans solar charging hub
stories.summary: Greenwheel Electric has submitted plans for a solar-powered charging hub at the Hunterston PARC industrial campus in North Ayrshire. The proposed site will feature 16 charging bays, including ultra-fast options, powered entirely by onsite solar panels.

stories.title: India launches hydrogen-powered train
stories.summary: Indian Railways has inaugurated its first indigenous hydrogen fuel cell-powered train. The locomotive generates electricity onboard using hydrogen and is set to operate on the Jind-Sonipat section of the Northern Railway, marking a shift toward alternative traction systems.

stories.title: Study highlights carbon benefits of component reuse
stories.summary: Researchers Arushi Jaswal and Stefan Könsgen have developed a model to track automotive components across multiple life cycles. The study suggests that downstream reuse pathways significantly alter cumulative carbon footprints compared to conventional single-life configurations, which often ignore secondary life cycles.

stories.title: Luxembourg extends EV subsidy to 2030
stories.summary: Luxembourg has extended its electric vehicle subsidy scheme through 2030. The program offers up to 6,000 euros for the most efficient vehicles, continuing the government's financial support for the transition to electric mobility.

stories.title: India urged to reshape climate finance at COP31
stories.summary: Indian policymakers are being encouraged to frame climate finance as a development issue at COP31. The goal is to shift negotiations from requesting funds to ensuring capital is available under conditions that allow developing countries to expand energy access while reducing emissions.

stories.title: UN climate summit focuses on electrification
stories.summary: The UN climate summit in Antalya is pushing for a global increase in electricity use to 35 percent of total energy consumption by 2035. The current global figure stands at 23 percent, with co-hosts seeking commitments from participating nations to accelerate the transition.

stories.title: Allegro MicroSystems reports 29 percent revenue growth
stories.summary: Allegro MicroSystems reported fiscal second-quarter 2027 net sales of 276.9 million dollars, a 29 percent increase from the previous year. The company attributed the growth to demand from AI data centers and automotive safety systems.

stories.title: European EV sales continue to outpace US
stories.summary: Battery-powered vehicle sales are rising in Europe as non-hybrid gas and diesel car sales decline. While the U.S. market faces polarization and policy reversals, Europe continues to see a shift toward fully electric and hybrid models.

stories.title: Chinese automakers display EVs at Prague e-SALON
stories.summary: Multiple Chinese automakers showcased new energy vehicles at the eighth e-SALON fair in Prague. The international event focuses on clean mobility technologies and solutions, featuring displays from brands including Leapmotor and BYD.

stories.title: Chinese EV brands gain visibility on German roads
stories.summary: German software engineer Renick Buettner drove a NIO EL7 to Regensburg on Germany's Unity Day. While domestic brands remain established, Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers are becoming increasingly visible on the country's roads. The car is now part of a more diverse traffic landscape.

stories.title: Global EV sales return to growth in October
stories.summary: Global sales of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles reached 2.09 million units in October, an 8 percent increase year-over-year. Europe led the growth with a 36 percent rise in sales, while year-to-date global figures show a 5 percent increase compared to the same period in 2025.

stories.title: BYD begins production at its largest factory outside Asia
stories.summary: BYD has opened its largest industrial plant outside of China in Camaçari, Brazil. The complex covers 4.6 million square meters and the company reports that it has already produced 100,000 vehicles. The factory represents one of China's largest industrial bets in Latin America.

stories.title: JLR cuts profit outlook as China demand weakens - Automotive News
Global EV sales rise 8 percent in October
stories.summary: Global electric vehicle sales reached 2.09 million in October, an 8 percent increase from the previous year. Europe saw battery electric sales jump 49 percent, while North America recorded its first annual increase of 2026. The market is currently recovering from a weak comparison month.
